summary: The trace demonstrates a successful honorarium request validation task that shares strong structural overlap with the existing multi-source-reconciliation skill. The agent used the same core pattern: cross-referencing records across Excel (speaker registry), CSV (session approvals), and PDF (requests), with fuzzy name matching for typos. The key insight is that this is the same capability with different entity names (speakers vs employees, fees vs amounts, approval codes vs trip IDs). Rather than create a duplicate skill, I will generalize the existing multi-source-reconciliation skill to cover both expense claims and honorarium validations, plus any similar cross-reference validation tasks. The skill name and description will be updated to be more inclusive, and the violation types reference will be expanded with the honorarium-specific patterns discovered.
